options.name: auto_attach
options.description: Set Auto-Attach on or off The C(auto_attach) parameter is deprecated since Katello 4.13 and not available after Katello 4.19

options.name: ca_path
options.description: PEM formatted file that contains a CA certificate to be used for validation. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_CA_PATH) will be used instead.

options.name: content_overrides
options.description: List of content overrides that include label and override state Label refers to repository C(content_label). For Red Hat products for example C(rhel-7-server-rpms). For custom products it's in the format C(<organization_label>_<product_label>_<repository_label>), e.g. C(ExampleOrg_ExampleProduct_ExampleRepository). Override state ('enabled', 'disabled', or 'default') sets initial state of repository for newly registered hosts

options.name: content_view
options.description: Name of the content view

options.name: content_view_environments
options.description: List of content view environments to add to activation key. Mutually exclusive with C(content_view) and C(lifecycle_environment).

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the activation key

options.name: host_collections
options.description: List of host collections to add to activation key

options.name: lifecycle_environment
options.description: Name of the lifecycle environment

options.name: max_hosts
options.description: Maximum number of registered content hosts. Required if I(unlimited_hosts=false)

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the activation key

options.name: new_name
options.description: Name of the new activation key when state == copied

options.name: oauth1_consumer_key
options.description: OAuth1 consumer key for accessing the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_OAUTH1_CONSUMER_KEY) will be used instead.

options.name: oauth1_consumer_secret
options.description: OAuth1 consumer secret for accessing the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_OAUTH1_CONSUMER_SECRET) will be used instead.

options.name: organization
options.description: Organization that the entity is in

options.name: password
options.description: Password of the user accessing the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: purpose_addons
options.description: Sets the system purpose add-ons

options.name: purpose_role
options.description: Sets the system purpose role

options.name: purpose_usage
options.description: Sets the system purpose usage

options.name: release_version
options.description: Set the content release version

options.name: server_url
options.description: URL of the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_SERVER_URL) will be used instead.

options.name: service_level
options.description: Set the service level

options.name: state
options.description: State of the Activation Key If C(copied) the key will be copied to a new one with I(new_name) as the name and all other fields left untouched C(present_with_defaults) will ensure the entity exists, but won't update existing ones

options.name: subscriptions
options.description: List of subscriptions that include either Name, Pool ID, or Upstream Pool ID. Pool IDs are preferred since Names and Upstream Pool IDs are not guaranteed to be unique. The module will fail if it finds more than one match. This parameter is not supported in SCA mode.

options.name: unlimited_hosts
options.description: Can the activation key have unlimited hosts

options.name: use_gssapi
options.description: Use GSSAPI to perform the authentication, typically this is for Kerberos or Kerberos through Negotiate authentication. Requires the Python library L(requests-gssapi,https://github.com/pythongssapi/requests-gssapi) to be installed. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_USE_GSSAPI) will be used instead.

options.name: username
options.description: Username accessing the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_USERNAME) will be used instead.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether or not to verify the TLS certificates of the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead.
